description: Plan one alternative-text repair for one exact image in one New Quizzes Item Bank question. Fresh-reads the course, bank, entry, and complete item; changes one selected missing alternative-text attribute; supplies exact bank and item snapshot digests; uses the admitted complete-item update with one dispatch and exact readback. No Canvas write occurs during planning.
executor_wiring: validated: catalog/a11y/runner.py plan mode loads this manifest, but the target kind has no live-proven read so the runner refuses with a named reason instead of guessing. dispatch/executor.py carries no a11y branches per the F-17 carve.

honesty.interpretation: This planner changes one image alt attribute only. It does not prove accessibility conformance.

multi_step.name: fresh_read_target
multi_step.note: Fresh-read the exact target (course, quiz/bank, and question/item as the kind requires). The read must return the complete saved body; an incomplete read refuses the plan.

multi_step.name: validate_repair_plan
multi_step.note: Validate the plan against the fresh audit evidence. Refusals: stale_body: the target changed since the signal; run the audit again; image_position_shifted: the image is no longer at this index; image_source_mismatch: the image at this index is not the signaled image; ambiguous_image: the same image is used more than once; decorative_needs_empty_alt / alt_text_required: alt_text/decorative inconsistency; protected_quiz: New Quiz 506477 is never touched. Planner-specific guards: Requires exact bank_sha256 and item_sha256 snapshot digests; stale snapshots refuse the plan. An item bank question image cannot be marked decorative; it needs alternative text a person can read. morrow_read_item_bank_fan_out output is review context only and never grants authority. Live-unproven on any connected Canvas tenant: the Item Banks browser frame path stays live-unverified.

multi_step.name: require_authorization
multi_step.note: Requires human approval or a selected valid Edit authority. No Canvas write occurs during planning.

multi_step.name: guarded_single_dispatch
multi_step.note: One dispatch of the reviewed single-alt update with exact readback of the saved target.

multi_step.name: re_audit_same_target
multi_step.note: Run morrow_audit_course_item again on the same course and target. Report which observed fields, digests, and source signals changed. Stop on stale, incomplete, held, or unverified evidence; do not retry a write automatically.

name: morrow_plan_item_bank_question_image_alt_repair

alt_text.description: Alternative text a person can read, or empty when marking decorative.

bank_sha256.description: Digest of the exact bank snapshot this repair was planned against.

decorative.description: Item bank question images cannot be marked decorative.

expected_body_sha256.description: Digest of the exact saved body this repair was planned against.

image_index.description: Position of the image in the saved field, counting every image from 1.

image_src_sha256.description: Digest of the selected image's src attribute from the fresh audit.

item_id.description: New Quiz item id, or Item Bank question item id.

item_sha256.description: Digest of the exact item bank question this repair was planned against.

An item bank question image cannot be marked decorative; it needs alternative text a person can read.
morrow_read_item_bank_fan_out output is review context only and never grants authority.
